scenarios.title: After-Hours Emergency
scenarios.subtitle: Burning smell + buzzing breaker panel, 11:48 PM

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Thank you for calling JobLatch AI Electrical 24/7 Dispatch. My name is Sarah. Are you reporting an electrical emergency, or calling to schedule service?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, this is Mike Reynolds. I smell burning plastic and there's a buzzing sound coming from the breaker panel in my basement. Half my kitchen just lost power.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Please listen carefully for your safety. A burning rubber or plastic smell indicates electrical wire insulation is dangerously overheating. If you can safely access your breaker panel, shut off the breaker for that circuit immediately. Do NOT touch any scorched, hot, buzzing, or discolored outlets, switches, or appliances. Unplug any devices connected to that circuit only if the cords and plugs are completely cool to the touch. I am alerting our on-call master electrician right now. What is your street address and best callback phone number so I can dispatch them immediately?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: It's 418 Oakwood Ave, Cherry Hill, New Jersey. My callback is 856-555-0142.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Emergency dispatch is confirmed under reference ZM-EMERG-1005. Marcus Vance (Master Electrician On-Call) is en route to 418 Oakwood Ave, Cherry Hill, New Jersey right now with an arrival window of within 45 to 60 minutes. Please step back from the electrical equipment, stay in a safe and dry location, and call 911 immediately if any open flame or smoke develops.

scenarios.title: Out-of-Area Filter
scenarios.subtitle: Whole-home rewiring request from Princeton, NJ

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Thank you for calling JobLatch AI Electrical 24/7 Dispatch. My name is Sarah. Are you reporting an electrical emergency, or calling to schedule service?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'm calling from Princeton, New Jersey. I need my whole house rewired. Do you cover my area? My number is 609-555-0199.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Thanks for calling. Unfortunately Princeton is outside our service area, so we're not able to schedule a technician there. We cover Cherry Hill, Moorestown, Haddonfield, Voorhees and the surrounding towns. I'd recommend contacting a licensed electrician local to Princeton. If you ever smell burning or see sparks, please leave the home and call 911.
